source_instruction: i need grey memory foam slippers with open toes.
query: I stopped by the community park on my walk over this morning, right as the local elementary school’s annual fall fair was setting up. The air smelled like spiced cider simmering in big metal pots and caramel apples being dipped, and a group of third graders was hauling armfuls of painted pumpkins to line the entrance path. One of the teachers even waved me over to look at the hand-painted tote bags the kids made for a fundraiser, all covered in goofy doodles of dogs and dinosaurs and rainbows, and I almost grabbed one before I remembered I already have three canvas totes crumpled in the backseat of my car that I never remember to bring into the store. I’ve heard the men’s slippers in stock right now include memory foam open toe styles, there’s that one color option I always go for that’s available too, and none of the options that show up cross over the amount I'm comfortable spending.
